judgment_calls_for_kilian.question: Which subscription revenue path for FY2027-29?
judgment_calls_for_kilian.context: Subscription revenue is ~93% of Netflix revenue and sets the NTM EPS the P/E leg prices. Netflix no longer reports members or revenue per member (ARM), so the path is paid members x ARM, both judgment. The set books members +5.0/+4.0/+3.5% (2025 was +8%: 301.2M to 325M+) and ARM +1.6/+2.5/+2.5%. FY27 ARM is only the carry-over of rises already made (US March 2026, UK September 2026); no new 2027 rise is booked because none is announced (moderately conservative, rule 0c). That puts FY27 revenue at +8.7%, below the CFO's aim to 'sustain double-digit revenue growth' and ~1.9% under consensus. The engine-sized alternatives move the research target (12m) by more than 5% both ways.

options.label: Booked: no new 2027 rise
options.reasoning: Only rises already made are counted: the March 2026 US rise (~+10% on UCAN's 43.7% of revenue) and the September 2026 UK rise (6.2% of revenue) carry into 2027; Netflix says only that member value 'lets us occasionally raise prices'. Members slow from 2025's +8% as UCAN and EMEA revenue growth fell to 10-11% through 2026.

options.label: US rise every ~14 months
options.reasoning: US rises came in January 2025 and March 2026, 14 months apart, and Netflix says the 2026 price changes 'have gone well'. Repeating that cadence (~May 2027, ~Jul 2028, ~Sep 2029, ~+10% each on UCAN) gives ARM +4.3/+3.6/+3.6% and FY27 revenue near +11%, in line with the CFO's double-digit aim and consensus $56.67B. No rises abroad are counted in it.

options.label: No rise after the 2026 lap
options.reasoning: If Netflix holds prices while the ad tier and new markets grow, ARM is only the FY27 carry-over (+1.6%) and flat in FY28-29.

options.label: Members slow faster
options.reasoning: Regional revenue growth fell all through 2026 (UCAN 17% to 11%, EMEA 18% to 11%), so members could slow to +3.5/+3/+3%.

options.label: Members nearer 2025's +8%
options.reasoning: 2025 added ~8% members after the paid-sharing wave had faded, and Q3 2026 churn improved globally and in the US, so +7/+5.5/+4.5% is possible.

judgment_calls_for_kilian.why: Moderately conservative per your rule 0c: a new rise and faster member growth have no dated evidence yet, and the booked path counts only price moves already made.
